en: This Vampir save data is corrupted.

note: Source has no final period; kept without.
Memory-card header title, piece 1 of 'Vampir(N) <name> STAGE1 Day 12'. Header title must stay double-byte Shift-JIS (see report).
Header title: the trailing space is field separator #1 and must be emitted as U+3000 (0x8140).
Header title: leading space = separator #2 (0x8140). No space before the stage digit: an extra 0x8140 would break the game's title parser.
In-game save list stage field; stage digit follows directly.
